section: Race summaries > Round 3 – China Shanghai International Circuit

entities.name: Michael Schumacher
entities.description: Schumacher would ultimately retire from the race after the first round of stops when it was discovered that one of his wheels had not been attached properly.

entities.name: Nico Rosberg
entities.description: Rosberg took an early lead in the race, and while his attempt to complete the race with only two pit stops came under threat from second-placed Jenson Button, a mistake by Button's pit crew during his final stop handed Rosberg a nineteen-second advantage over Kimi Räikkönen.

entities.name: Jenson Button
entities.description: Button was second-placed and had a mistake by his pit crew during his final stop.

entities.name: Kimi Räikkönen
entities.description: Räikkönen was mentioned as being behind Rosberg.
